question: Open diagnostic question (no root cause presumed): Why does secondary settling performance fail while terminal reach succeeds? Which observable differences are actually separable within the retained evidence and the authorized bounded checks — specifically (a) recorded applied tension versus an instantaneous braking-box input at the same saved projected state over the fixed short horizon, and (b) two local controller solves at the same saved state/previous input/horizon differing by exactly one adopted weight — and which candidate explanations (objective weighting, seed/iteration selection, horizon or deadline effects, backend-model mismatch) remain mutually indistinguishable with these tools? The question is deliberately open about direction; it asks what can be distinguished, not what is already known to be the cause.
